The non-smooth event is bounded under the encryptor's W by its probability under a uniform W plus the leftover-hash distance of W (closeTo_genW: [A | H - A R] is within lnk sqrt(q^{ln}/2^{mb})/2 of uniform by closeTo_binaryHash_bind and the bijection (A, V) -> [A | H - V]), and the uniform count is card_bad_stacked.
